items.docs:
Retrieve a list of all available real-time data streams.

Optional query parameters can be used to filter results. All filters
use case-insensitive partial matching.

Retrieve connection details and protocol documentation for the real-time
data WebSocket endpoint.

The WebSocket endpoint itself is at `/api/v1/rt/ws` and is not shown in
the OpenAPI schema because WebSocket routes are not part of the OpenAPI
specification. This endpoint provides the protocol documentation instead.

items.docs:
Retrieve the latest data for a given real-time data stream.

Notes:
  - The `id` can be determined by using the stream listing endpoint.
  - The response content type depends on the stream's mimetype (e.g., image/jpeg).
  - Data is sourced from the database, populated by the RT ingester services.
  - The response includes an `x-rt-stream-last-updated-utc` header with the ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the stream data was last updated.
